name: Pit's Protection

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You are protected from physical harm. You gain resistance 5 to non-magical physical damage (except silver). Once per day, at any distance, the devil who holds this bargained contract can invoke a punitive damages clause as a single action with the concentrate trait to deal fire damage to you equal to twice your level (2*@actor.level fire), ignoring resistances, and gain half that many Hit Points.

Activate—Reasonable Force 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cite a right of self-defense article in your contract. The contract casts Diabolical Mantle, and you can then shove or demoralize an adjacent creature.
